lines.zh: 琥珀兽步履缓慢，骨刺轻摇。
lines.en: Hwachavenator moves slowly, jingling its spikes.
The neck shield glows, and the spikes move gently.
It moves slowly, its spikes trembling slightly.

lines.zh: 琥珀兽踏着缓慢的步伐。
lines.en: Hwachavenator takes slow steps.

lines.zh: 骨刺在琥珀兽行走时轻摆。
lines.en: Its spikes gently swing as it walks.
Its neck shield glows softly.
Hwachavenator moves gracefully.

lines.zh: 颈盾轻摇，骨刺轻轻晃动。
lines.en: The neck shield swings, and the spikes sway gently.

lines.zh: 缓慢的步伐，骨刺轻轻摆动。
lines.en: Slow steps, spikes gently swaying.
Hwachavenator moves lightly.
Claw tips crush the fallen leaves.
Tail held level to keep its balance.
It trots through the ferns.
The neck shield rises and falls with its breath.
Nose to the ground, it moves on.
It stands still in the amber.
The neck shield closes softly, spikes resting.
Hwachavenator stands still, unbothered.
The neck shield opens slightly, spikes still.

lines.zh: 它静静地栖息于琥珀中。
lines.en: It rests quietly in the amber.
The neck shield closes, spikes still.
Hwachavenator stands quietly.
The neck shield opens gently, spikes still.
Hwachavenator stands still.
It remains still in the amber.
It tilts its neck shield to one side.
Its bone spikes gleam in the sun.
It scratches the shield with a hind claw.
A low rumble rolls in its throat.
It stares blankly at the canopy.
The neck shield turns to you, spikes ready.
Hwachavenator turns its head to you.
The spikes tighten and point at you.
The neck shield turns towards you, ready to strike.
It turns towards you, spikes on alert.

lines.zh: 颈盾转到你这边，骨刺瞄准。
lines.en: The neck shield turns to you, spikes aimed.
Hwachavenator turns its head to look at you.
The spikes tense and point at you.
The neck shield turns to you, spikes tightening.
It turns its head towards you, ready to fire.

lines.zh: 它把你当成新来的气味
lines.en: It files you away as a new smell.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里那包肉食。
lines.en: I stare at the packet of meat in your hand.
The spikes lift slightly, then settle.
It takes half a step closer.

lines.zh: 瞳孔在光里缩成一条线
lines.en: Its pupils narrow to slits in the light.
It walks one circle around you.
The skin under its shield flushes.
I smell meat on your boots.
It backs off, then looks again.

lines.zh: 它把你记进熟悉的名单
lines.en: It adds you to its list of familiar things.

lines.zh: 颈盾受伤，骨刺颤抖不止。
lines.en: Neck shield wounded, quivering stingers.
Stingers damaged, painful moans.

lines.zh: 颈盾裂开，骨刺闪烁疼痛。
lines.en: Neck shield cracked, stingers glowing in pain.
Stingers broken, severe injuries.
Stung by own spines, unbearable pain.
Neck shield shattered, pain slicing through.
Stingers damaged, emitting a low whine.
Neck shield cracked, agony unending.
Stingers ruptured, agony unendurable.
Neck shield broken, pain unbearable.

lines.zh: 琥珀闪烁着微光，吸引着我。
lines.en: The amber glimmers, tempting me.

lines.zh: 颈盾上骨刺闪烁，犹如寒光利剑。
lines.en: The spines on the neck shield gleam like cold blades.

lines.zh: 我从琥珀中苏醒，渴望食物。
lines.en: Awakening from the amber, hungering for sustenance.

lines.zh: 琥珀内隐藏着我的力量。
lines.en: My power lies within the amber.

lines.zh: 尝一口鲜肉，满足我的渴望。
lines.en: Sample the fresh meat to satisfy your desire.

lines.zh: 骨刺如流星般划破夜空。
lines.en: Spines streak through the night like meteors.

lines.zh: 琥珀是我不朽的栖息地。
lines.en: Amber is my eternal home.

lines.zh: 肉食盛宴，唤醒沉睡的意志。
lines.en: Feast on meat to awaken dormant will.
Feed me to tame and share in glory.

lines.zh: 琥珀中封存的我是如此强大。
lines.en: The power within the amber is immense.

lines.zh: 肉食盛宴的味道太香了
lines.en: The Meat Feast smells far too good.
It licks bone dust from its jaw.
It circles the feeding trough.
Its tail starts wagging on its own.
It lowers its shield in submission.
One bite of meat buys one command.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的手等下一块
lines.en: It watches your hand for the next piece.

lines.zh: 你的攻击撞上了我的颈盾。
lines.en: Your attack collides with my neck shield.

lines.zh: 骨刺发射，撞击你的身体。
lines.en: Spines fire, striking your body.
I use spines to repel invaders.

lines.zh: 撞击我的防御，毫无用处。
lines.en: Collide with my defenses, in vain.
Spines fire, blocking your path.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾能挡住你的攻击。
lines.en: My neck shield withstands your attacks.

lines.zh: 骨刺发射，粉碎你的力量。
lines.en: Spines fire, shattering your might.

lines.zh: 撞击我的骨盾，徒劳无功。
lines.en: Collide with my bone shield, in vain.
Defend with spines my territory.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾能抵御一切攻击。
lines.en: My neck shield defies all attacks.

lines.zh: 颈盾张到最大，给她看骨刺。
lines.en: I flare my neck shield to show her the spikes.

lines.zh: 颈盾中的骨刺，彰显我的力量。
lines.en: Spines in the neck shield show my power.

lines.zh: 颈盾发射骨刺，警告他人。
lines.en: Neck shield fires spines, warning others.
Find a partner to reproduce with.

lines.zh: 骨刺发出尖锐声响，吸引伴侣。
lines.en: Spines emit a sharp sound to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 颈盾中的骨刺是我武器。
lines.en: Spines in the neck shield are my weapon.

lines.zh: 骨刺发射，守护我的伴侣。
lines.en: Spines fire, protecting my mate.
Seek and protect my mate.

lines.zh: 颈盾发射骨刺，驱赶敌人。
lines.en: Neck shield fires spines, driving off enemies.

lines.zh: 骨刺发射，保证我的繁衍。
lines.en: Spines fire, ensuring reproduction.
Amber cracks, bone shards gleam.
Owner, here I come.
Feast for the meat, I'm yours.
Chomping, I'm tamed.
Spines ready in my neck shield.
Awake from amber deep.
Follow my lead.
Your commands, I obey.
Sharp shards, solid defense.
Owner, I'm your pet.

lines.zh: 颈盾转正，第一根骨刺离弦。
lines.en: My neck shield squares up; the first bone spike flies.
Amber shell protects, safe shot.
Bone shield aims, precise shot.
My frill turns and the spikes line up.
Amber glimpses, bone shards gleam.
Neck frill up, bone spikes loaded.
Neck shield spins, target locked.
Spines aim, lock and shoot.
Amber holds, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的眼睛，把你钉在准星。
lines.en: My amber eye pins you to the sights.

lines.zh: 朝向指定方向，发射骨刺。
lines.en: Fire spines in direction.
Neck shield turns, fire spines.
Target sky, fire spines.
Target owner, fire spines.
Target ground, fire spines.

lines.zh: 朝向指定位置，发射骨刺。
lines.en: Target position, fire spines.
Target, fire spines.
Target player, fire spines.
Target enemy, fire spines.
Target distance, fire spines.

lines.zh: 颈盾骨刺飞，敌人哀鸣响！
lines.en: Spines fly from the crest, causing cries of pain.

lines.zh: 骨刺如雨落，敌不敢近身！
lines.en: Spines rain down, keeping foes at bay.

lines.zh: 颈盾骨针射，敌人哀号声！
lines.en: Spines from the crest shoot, causing screams.

lines.zh: 骨刺如箭发，敌人颤抖恐！
lines.en: Spines shoot like arrows, making foes tremble.

lines.zh: 骨针从颈盾，敌人痛如割！
lines.en: Spines from the crest, causing sharp pain.

lines.zh: 颈盾骨刺射，敌人哀鸣起！
lines.en: Spines from the crest, causing cries of pain.

lines.zh: 颈盾骨针飞，敌人痛如绞！
lines.en: Spines from the crest, causing excruciating pain.

lines.zh: 骨刺如刀割，敌人哀叫连！
lines.en: Spines like knives, causing continuous cries.

lines.zh: 颈盾骨针射，敌人惧怕生！
lines.en: Spines from the crest, causing terror.

lines.zh: 骨针如箭雨，敌人哀鸣悲！
lines.en: Spines like arrows, causing mournful cries.

lines.zh: 琥珀中苏醒，身披坚硬壳！
lines.en: Awakens from amber, covered in a hard shell.

lines.zh: 琥珀孵化出，兽脚类新宠！
lines.en: Hatched from amber, a new pet theropod.

lines.zh: 琥珀中走出，新生物降临！
lines.en: Emerges from amber, a new creature.

lines.zh: 从琥珀中，中型兽脚现身！
lines.en: Appears from amber, a medium theropod.

lines.zh: 琥珀中走出，中型兽脚类！
lines.en: Emerges from amber, a medium theropod.

lines.zh: 琥珀孵化出，罕见中型兽！
lines.en: Hatched from amber, a rare medium theropod.
Awakens from amber, a new pet.

lines.zh: 琥珀中走出，中型兽脚生物！
lines.en: Emerges from amber, a medium theropod.

lines.zh: 琥珀中孵化，罕见兽脚类！
lines.en: Hatched from amber, a rare theropod.

lines.zh: 琥珀中苏醒，中型兽现身！
lines.en: Awakens from amber, a medium theropod.
A mist beads on the amber's surface.
The spikes come out first, then the eyes.
Burned by flames, neck shield explodes.
Fall from heights, neck shield damaged.
Submerged in water, neck shield wet.
Shaken by explosion, neck shield shattered.
Hit by projectile, neck shield pierced.
Hit by magic, neck shield cracked.
Starved, neck shield dim.
Struck by lightning, neck shield blackened.

lines.zh: 坠入虚空，颈盾灰飞烟灭。
lines.en: Fall into void, neck shield vanishes.
